	print("e2 index:", world.get_index(e2), " gen:", world.get_generation(e2))
	print("alive e1:", world.is_alive(e1), " alive e2:", world.is_alive(e2))

	print("\n--- Test 2: Components and Migration ---")
	world.add_component(e1, &"pos", {"x": 1, "y": 2})
	print("has pos e1:", world.has_component(e1, &"pos"))
	print("has vel e1:", world.has_component(e1, &"vel"))
	print("comp pos e1:", world.get_component(e1, &"pos"))
	world.add_component(e1, &"vel", {"vx": 3, "vy": 4})
	print("types e1:", world.get_component_types(e1))

	print("\n--- Test 3: Removal and Preservation ---")
	world.remove_component(e1, &"pos")
	print("has pos e1:", world.has_component(e1, &"pos"))
	print("has vel e1:", world.has_component(e1, &"vel"))
	print("comp vel e1:", world.get_component(e1, &"vel"))
	print("types e1:", world.get_component_types(e1))

	print("\n--- Test 4: Destroy and Reuse ---")
	world.destroy_entity(e1)
	print("alive e1:", world.is_alive(e1))
	e3 := world.create_entity()
	print("e3 index:", world.get_index(e3), " gen:", world.get_generation(e3))
	print("alive e1 (old):", world.is_alive(e1))
	print("alive e3:", world.is_alive(e3))
	print("add_comp stale e1:", world.add_component(e1, &"pos", {}))
	print("has_comp stale e1:", world.has_component(e1, &"pos"))

	print("\n--- Test 5: Querying ---")
	e4 := world.create_entity()
	e5 := world.create_entity()
	e6 := world.create_entity()
	world.add_component(e4, &"pos", {})
	world.add_component(e4, &"vel", {})
	world.add_component(e5, &"pos", {})
	world.add_component(e6, &"vel", {})
	print("query pos:", world.query([&"pos"]))
	print("query vel:", world.query([&"vel"]))
	print("query pos+vel:", world.query([&"pos", &"vel"]))
	print("exact [pos]:", world.get_entities_with_exact_types([&"pos"]))

	quit()
